description: Balance-Druid-style ranged caster - Dawnsear/Sunflare lock you into Sunrise (Holy) or Sunset (Fire) via Dawn, then Radiant Flame/Horusath Blast/Rapture pay off staying committed to one school.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc (real playstyle/rotation/ability names) + confirmed screenshot numbers where available. Real mechanic per handoff: after Dawn, Holy casts grant Sunrise, Fire casts grant Sunset - entering one locks out the other until the next Dawn cycle (real Solar/Lunar Eclipse analog). Laid out as 3 parallel vertical branches (left=Sunset/Fire, center=shared Eclipse mechanic, right=Sunrise/Holy) rather than one long horizontal sprawl - every node capped at 5 ranks max per Kyle's direction.

nodes.name: Piety
nodes.description: Increases critical strike chance and hit chance from Intellect by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Piety - Level 15 Passive. Crit chance from Intellect; boosts hit chance.'

nodes.name: Cleanser of Sins
nodes.description: Increases Fire spell critical strike damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts Fire spell crit damage.'

nodes.name: Scalding Light
nodes.description: Increases Fire spell critical strike damage by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Dawnsear
nodes.description: Learn Dawnsear, a Fire damage nuke.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Fire damage nuke.' Piety's Sunset-side primary nuke, paired with Sunflare's Sunrise-side Holy version.

nodes.name: Burning Light
nodes.description: Your critical strikes set the target alight, dealing Fire damage over 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Damaging crits set a periodic Fire DoT (can crit).'

nodes.name: Sunburn
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Rapture by 4% per rank. Rapture leaves a burn dealing 25 Fire damage per turn for 3 turns.

nodes.name: Rapture
nodes.description: Learn Rapture, a Fire damage burst that pierces all immunities, hitting the target and nearby enemies for reduced damage per enemy struck.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: 'Call down a streak of sun light to smite your target, dealing 144 Fire damage to them and nearby enemies, piercing all immunities, but dealing less damage with each enemy struck.'

nodes.name: Wrathful Sun
nodes.description: Increases Rapture damage by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts Rapture damage.' Piety's capstone-tier Fire finisher payoff.

nodes.name: Struck by the Sun
nodes.description: Increases your spell power by 2% of your Intellect per rank, and your Holy and Fire spell damage by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts Holy+Fire spell damage + spell hit from Intellect.'

nodes.name: Sunrise and Sunset
nodes.description: Your Holy spells grant Sunrise, increasing spell power by 50 for 4 turns. Entering Sunrise removes Sunset.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 10 Passive. After Dawn, Holy casts grant Sunrise, Fire casts grant Sunset; entering one locks out the other until the next cycle.' Piety's real Eclipse-lock identity mechanic, sitting at the center of the tree since both branches key off it.

nodes.name: Duality of Light
nodes.description: Your Fire spells grant Sunset, increasing damage dealt by 10% for 4 turns. Entering Sunset removes Sunrise.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Sunset Holy damage grants Twin Flame; Sunrise Fire damage grants Sun Power. Only one active.' Rewards staying committed to whichever school Sunrise/Sunset locked you into.

nodes.name: Learning Light
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 20% chance per rank to increase your spell haste by 15% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Entering Sunrise/Sunset boosts spell haste (limited duration/casts).'

nodes.name: Solar Concord
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 25% chance to reset the cooldown of Rapture.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Resets Horusath Blast (Sunrise) or Rapture (Sunset) cooldown; their damage launches a Solar Flare.'

nodes.name: Photosynthetic
nodes.description: Increases your spell haste by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts spell haste, more at daytime.'

nodes.name: Grace
nodes.description: Increases Sunflare spell damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts Dawnsear/Sunflare spell damage bonus.'

nodes.name: Solar Conduit
nodes.description: Radiant Flame has a 20% chance per rank to generate 1 Solar Power.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Piety Sun Cleric Passive Hidden2 - Radiant Flame/Solar Wrath generate 1 Solar Power.'

nodes.name: Radiant Flame
nodes.description: Learn Radiant Flame, a channeled repeating Holyflame damage spell.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Repeating Holyflame damage.' Piety's sustained-damage channel.

nodes.name: Purgation
nodes.description: Radiant Flame has a 20% chance per rank to sear away 60 of the target's Armor for 3 turns.

nodes.name: Radiant Fury
nodes.description: Increases Radiant Flame damage by 5% per rank, and all of your damage over time by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Radiant Flame damage boosted vs. <35%-health enemies.'

nodes.name: Ancient Etchings
nodes.description: Your Sunflare casts grant Ancient Etchings, increasing spell power by 20 for 4 turns and stacking up to 5 times.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Holy damage reduces Horusath Blast cast time (stacking).' Class-wide Horusath Blast is Piety's real single-target burst button once these stacks are up.

nodes.name: Sun Gate
nodes.description: Learn Sun Gate, a forward blink that removes root effects and leaves a gate allies can use once.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Piety's real mobility/escape tool: 'Forward blink, removes root; leaves a gate allies can use once.'
